formula: L = alpha*CE(text_pred, text_target) + beta*MSE(tension_pred, tension_target) + gamma*MSE(bold_pred, bold_target) + delta*max(0, phi_star_threshold - phi_star(model))

L_chat.description: next-token cross-entropy over assistant response tokens

L_tension.description: per-step tension consistency vs target trajectory

L_bold.description: TRIBE-projected BOLD consistency on 10242 fsaverage5 vertices

L_phi.description: hard-floor regularizer; zero when phi_star >= threshold
L_phi.compute_cost: phi_star verifier ~30s per microbatch -> evaluate every 100 steps, EMA-smoothed

balance_strategy: Pareto frontier sweep via Latin Hypercube on (alpha, beta, gamma, delta); sample 9 of 81 combos
honest_c3_loss: 4-loss balance Pareto unverified — sweep is heuristic
phi_star regularizer is post-hoc proxy not differentiable directly; gradient via straight-through estimator on EMA
BOLD MSE assumes TRIBE v2 forward is faithful (simulated)
tension consistency only meaningful if base CLM trajectories are stationary on similar prompts (test)
